steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap yellow ochre into the brush and crisscross the center
steps.load: small amount tapped into the bristles

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: touch alizarin crimson into the yellow and blend warmth
steps.load: touch picked up without cleaning
steps.rule: adds a little warmth to the sky

steps.subject: water
steps.action: drop the warm color into the lower area for water
steps.load: same brush
steps.where: lower area where the water will be

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: load midnight black and crisscross shapes in the sky
steps.load: loaded on the brush

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add a touch of phthalo blue and pull from the outside in
steps.load: touch of blue added to the black
steps.where: outer sky around the light area
steps.rule: keeps light showing through the center when finished

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull a little dark water color in from the outside

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the sky colors until the edges disappear
steps.load: brush washed, then loaded from the light area

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: load midnight black and phthalo blue for the mountain roll
steps.load: pulled out very flat and cut across
steps.rule: only the outside edge matters at this stage

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add grey highlights on the mountain
steps.load: grey roll cut off the knife
steps.motion: barely touch and let it play

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: mix lavender and touch the colors onto the mountain
steps.load: small roll cut off the knife edge, kept marbled

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull colors down on the shadow side
steps.rule: lets the colors mix without overworking

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: barely graze dark sienna and white over the mountain
steps.load: tiny bit on the small knife edge

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: drop dark shadow areas and let colors overlap

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist at the mountain base following the angles
steps.load: clean dry brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add plains to the mountain with mountain colors
steps.load: mountain colors on the brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap lavender-black mix into the mountain following the angles
steps.load: tapped mix from the brush
steps.rule: tapping helps create the illusion of distance and depth

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist into the mountain with a clean brush
steps.load: clean brush
steps.rule: tapping mixes with liquid white so it softens

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull a foothill down with the corner of the brush
steps.load: mountain colors with sap green on the brush

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: drop reflections under the foothill and pull straight down
steps.load: same mix on the brush
steps.motion: pull straight down, then lightly across
steps.rule: reflections must come straight down to read as water

steps.subject: land
steps.action: load black and sap green on a 1in and pull across
steps.load: lots of paint loaded into the bristles

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: drop in small bush shapes along the water edge
steps.load: same brush
steps.motion: drop in shapes that get smaller going back
steps.where: along the edge of the water
steps.rule: smaller shapes make them look farther away

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: add far bushes and trees with yellow ochre, sap green and black
steps.load: lots of paint, black and yellow mixed for green
steps.motion: drop in and turn the brush

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: reflect the far bushes with a straight pull down
steps.load: same brush turned over

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut straight water lines across the canvas
steps.load: liquid white cut across on the palette

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: load a 2in to a chisel edge and push in an evergreen
steps.load: bristles loaded full and sharpened

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: drop in a big evergreen and bring it down
steps.load: same brush

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: push in small bushes on the side
steps.load: same brush

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scratch in trunk marks on the trees
steps.load: small roll on the knife

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: work highlights back and forth with a chisel edge
steps.load: pulled to a sharp chiseled edge
steps.where: where light would strike the trees
steps.rule: warns not to cover all the dark

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add highlights on the big trees on the other side
steps.load: same brush

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: dab three yellows as highlights and reflect them
steps.load: loaded full of paint, one direction
steps.motion: pull straight down, then reflect in layers

steps.subject: land
steps.action: add land with van dyke brown and grey rocks
steps.load: grey from the mountain mix on the knife

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: add a liquid white water line along the bottom
steps.load: liquid white on the knife edge

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add orange accents with bright red and cadmium yellow
steps.load: paint thinner or liquid white added to help it stick
steps.rule: layers keep the painting from looking flat

steps.subject: path
steps.action: pull a brown path across with the knife
steps.load: brown and dark sienna pulled out, white barely touched

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting with thinned bright red
steps.load: thinned with liquid clear
